pathIdentity.result: Each constructed variant refuses before worktree creation without branch or registration residue. Existing mode-000 directories refuse; canonical whitespace-ending directories pass the identity guards. A Git-registered variant yields one named beacon refusal while a healthy row and group cache remain readable. On a second registered worktree, a mode-000 beacon directory, a searchable but unlistable one and a sealed parent each yield that row's refusal with its directory and reason while the healthy row is swept; single-root guards refuse naming the directory.

repair.rule: Labeled error statuses keep internal punctuation, working predicates admit adverbs, and negated failure subjects keep polarity through passive predicates.
repair.controls: Both supplied classes and both entries are executed; baseline findings make no worker, push or PR call; healthy passive wording reaches resolved with exactly one local fixture push and one fixture PR.
repair.boundary: Existing wider-vocabulary and ambiguity planner question remains D023. No general English classification guarantee is claimed.
